expected_rate: event-driven: one 'locked' line when a QHM hold closes through its own exits, then one line per bot start while a sold pick is re-checked (QHM closed holds now: GE, GEV, LLY, NVDA, GOOGL history; several per week)
window_reason: QHM closes are not daily; ten sessions covers the recent close and restart rate.
reversal: a QHM buy of a symbol whose prior hold closed through a QHM exit, before that symbol's next earnings report, without a 'released reason=dip_trigger' line whose close and ask are at or below the trigger; a released buy that is not a limit at the trigger; an owner-sold or unexplained-close hold released by a dip; after 10 locked cases, a negative cumulative score of locked cases vs an immediate re-buy (owner review)

metrics.name: QHM re-buys above the prior QHM exit price before earnings
metrics.source: Alpaca fills (QH- client ids) vs the qhm_reentry events in trade_events.jsonl
metrics.bound: zero without a released dip_trigger event

metrics.name: locked cases scored at their earnings release vs an immediate re-buy
metrics.bound: cumulative score >= 0 after the first 10 locked cases, else back to the owner

baseline_exempt_reason: The proof line text 'QHM reentry <SYM>: locked|released reason=' is new, emitted only by this change; it does not appear in the production log before this ship.
